title: On this day in space! Nov. 1, 1962: The Soviet Union Launches Mars 1 spacecraft to Red Planet during the Space Race
caption:
On November 1, 1962, the Soviet Union launched Mars 1 toward the Red Planet after three consecutive launch failures. A thruster leak crippled its ability to point home, cutting off transmissions halfway through its journey.

Source: Space - On this day in space! Nov. 1, 1962: The Soviet Union Launches Mars 1 spacecraft to Red Planet during the Space Race
